# FabricOps Starter Kit

> FabricOps (Fabric Operations) is a plug-and-play, lightweight starter kit that helps governance, data engineering, and AI and BI analytics teams adopt a standardized Microsoft Fabric notebook workflow.

Use this file as a concise navigation map for documentation and automation workflows. Follow the same reader journey as the human documentation instead of treating individual reference pages as standalone product explanations.

## Start with the product story

- [Documentation Home](index.md): Why FabricOps exists, who it supports, what is included, and the recommended learning path.
- [How FabricOps Works](how-fabricops-works.md): How the package, notebook templates, roles, Fabric items, and metadata tables work together.
- [Guided Demo](guided-demo.md): Canonical execution path from Fabric setup through guarded pipeline execution and metadata inspection.

## Guided Demo sequence

- [Setup Fabric Artifacts](guided-demo/setup-fabric-artifacts.md): Prepare the workspace, Fabric data items, Environment, release wheel, and copied notebooks.
- [Run Environment Setup](guided-demo/run-environment-setup.md): Configure shared runtime values and the metadata target with `00_env_config`.
- [Run IO and Profiling Demo](guided-demo/run-io-and-profiling-demo.md): Validate configured Lakehouse and Warehouse routes with `99_explore`.
- [Register Agreement](guided-demo/create-agreement.md): Record steward and agreement context with `01_agreement`.
- [Run a Data Pipeline](guided-demo/run-pipeline.md): Record catalogue, profile, and lineage evidence with `02_pipeline`.
- [Review Governance](guided-demo/review-guardrails.md): Enrich observed metadata and approve executable guardrail intent with `03_governance`.
- [Run a Data Pipeline with Guardrails](guided-demo/run-pipeline-with-guardrails.md): Evaluate active approved rules against fresh data.
- [Explore Metadata](guided-demo/explore-metadata-outputs.md): Trace agreement, catalogue, profile, lineage, enrichment, guardrail, and result evidence.

## Build with the starter kit

- [Notebook Templates](notebook-templates-implementation-guide/index.md): Download links, notebook responsibilities, and the maintained workflow sequence.
- [Function Reference](reference/index.md): Generated public callable catalogue and links to individual function contracts.
- [Metadata Table Reference](reference/metadata.md): Implemented metadata responsibilities, relationships, schemas, and writer ownership.
- [DQ Rule Reference](reference/dq-rules/index.md): Supported rule types, parameters, examples, and runtime behavior.
- [Releases](releases/index.md): Version-specific function and metadata lifecycle contracts and downloadable assets.

## Handover and maintenance

- [Product Narrative](maintainer/product-narrative.md): Canonical messaging, scope, terminology, and page ownership.
- [Release Guide](maintainer/index.md): Maintainer procedure for release curation, lifecycle decisions, generation, validation, and publishing.
- [Public API & Architecture](maintainer/public-api-architecture.md): Supported API boundaries, call-flow contracts, generated references, and dashboard review.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/Voycepeh/FabricOps-Starter-Kit/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Contribution workflow and expectations.
- [Repository README](https://github.com/Voycepeh/FabricOps-Starter-Kit/blob/main/README.md): Concise repository entry point and published documentation links.

## Navigation rule

Use the canonical detailed page for each topic. Do not copy architecture into the README, execution steps into the documentation home page, or hand-maintained function details into generated API reference pages.
